newsitem.title: UK: European straight-run fuel oils stable, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: European straight-run fuel oils stable, trade thin.

text.p: European straight run fuel oil prices were stable in thin trade on Tuesday.
Traders said some interest persisted for Russian material, but otherwise demand was thin.
North Sea low sulphur values stood unchanged at a notional $105/$108 a tonne for fob liftings, but traders said the dearth of demand saw some equity holders eyeing trans-Atlantic options.
Dealers said Russian material continued to appear at Baltic ports at attractive prices with E4 valued around $95 a tonne.
In the Mediterranean, Russian M-40 was valued around two means +$6 a tonne delivered.
